social.handle: WINORR - Wildlife In Need of Rescue and Rehabilitation

notes:
Non-profit run by licensed rehabbers Bobby & Cathy Horvath from their North Massapequa home for 20+ years (~700 animals/yr). Licensed at state AND federal level, so can take federally protected species incl. raptors. The usual go-to rehabbers for NYC raptors; will advise/help on anything, everywhere, with no hour limitation. Also offer sanctuary/placement for non-releasable wildlife. Listed as NYC-region rehabbers by NYC Bird Alliance

Some contact details for this entry are personal and are withheld until the individual confirms they want to be listed publicly.
